description: Append an immutable audit event to the action_timeline table. This table is append-only; rows are never updated or deleted. Every significant agent action, human decision, and system mutation MUST be recorded here to satisfy the auditability requirement.

actor_type.description: Category of the actor that produced this event.

actor_id.description: Specific identifier of the actor (e.g. agent name 'zdl_governance', username 'alice', or system component 'lambda-ingest').

finding_id.description: UUID of the finding this event relates to. Nullable — omit for events not scoped to a single finding.

target_table.description: Name of the database table that was the subject of this action (e.g. 'findings', 'decisions', 'assets').

target_id.description: String identifier of the specific row that was acted on (typically a UUID cast to string).

payload_json.description: Arbitrary structured payload providing event-specific detail. For policy_check events include matched_rule_name and decision. For approval events include approver and rationale. Keep payloads concise and machine-parseable.
